question: The Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Amendment) Bill, 2022, was introduced in Lok Sabha on 7 February 2022 by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Arjun Munda**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **2022, the Lok Sabha** received the **Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Second Amendment) Bill.**
 
• **Arjun Munda** introduced it in the Lok Sabha.
 
• The **Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950**, as it relates to** Tamil Nadu**, is to be amended by the bill.
 
• In states and union territories, the Order identifies the **tribal group**s that are considered to be** Scheduled Tribes.**
 
• After this Bill is approved, the Gond group will be moved from the list of** SCs to the list of ST**s, and the** Dhuria, Nayak, Ojha, Pathari, and Rajgond** will be added to the list of STs in **Uttar Pradesh** in the four districts of **Sant Kabir Nagar, Kushinagar, Chandauli, and Bhadohi.**
 
• The **Narikoravan and Kurivikkaran communities** are listed among the Scheduled Tribes in the Bill in Tamil Nadu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arjun Munda:**

 
 
• Arjun Munda is an **Indian politician.**
 
• He currently serves as the Second Mod**i ministry's Minister of Tribal Affairs.**
 
 
 
• **Ramesh Bidhuri:**
 
 
• Ramesh Bidhuri is a** Bharatiya Janata Party supporter** and member of the Indian Parliament.
 
 
 
• **Amit Shah:**
 
 
• Amit Shah is a politician from India who has been the country's **first Minister of Cooperation since 2021** and **Minister of Home Affairs **since 2019.
 
 
 
• **Rajnath Singh:**
 
 
• Indian politician Rajnath Singh currently holds the position of** defense minister.**
 
• He serves as the** Lok Sabha's deputy leader **at the moment.
